_comment: Origins of every external input used by the governance-integrity experiment. Snapshot dates are when this session fetched the artifact (2026-10-11). Hashes: git commit SHA-1 for repositories, SHA-256 of the npm tarball and the registry's SRI integrity string for packages, SHA-256 of file content for individual files. Nothing listed here was modified; copies placed under inputs/ are hashed again in inputs/MANIFEST.json.
network_limits: Container egress reached github.com (git), raw.githubusercontent.com, registry.npmjs.org and pypi.org only. legifrance.gouv.fr, urssaf.fr, service-public.fr, data.gouv.fr, echanges.dila.gouv.fr, politique.pappers.fr, nyc.gov and web.archive.org were unreachable from both the container and the web-fetch tool.
